Kimberly / Jordan —

Attached is a working spreadsheet (model-shortlist-estimates.xlsx) — below are the highlights and the assumptions I used (so you can tweak if needed). This is intentionally conservative on tokens to avoid under-provisioning.

Assumptions (examples):
- Interactive chat: median prompt = 350 tokens, median completion = 150 tokens (median per-request = 500 tokens). 95th percentile per-request = 2,200 tokens (long context + long reply).
- Multi-doc summarization: median prompt = 2,200 tokens (multiple docs concatenated), completion = 400 tokens (median per-request = 2,600 tokens). 95th percentile = 6,000 tokens.
- Reranking/batch jobs: average job = 20 queries x 120 tokens each = 2,400 tokens; these run as scheduled batches.

Traffic profile (we used your early-adopter ramp):
- Month 1: 500 DAU -> ~2.4M tokens/month
- Month 3: 3k DAU -> ~14M tokens/month
- Month 6 (pilot scaling): 10k DAU -> ~48M tokens/month
- Peak daily concurrency (Q4 projection): ~800 concurrent interactive sessions at spikes (short tails matter for latency planning)

Model shortlist (tradeoffs & quick recommendation):
1) 16k-context instruction-tuned medium model (best fit for multi-doc summarization + long chat)
   - Latency: moderate (200-400ms for short completions, 800-1500ms for long summaries on optimized nodes)
   - Cost: medium-high; best quality for preserving long context
2) 8k-context high-throughput quantized model (good for chat where latency is primary)
   - Latency: low (100-200ms typical for short replies on batching-friendly hardware)
   - Cost: lower due to quantization + batching
3) Smaller distilled model for cheap reranking/bulk inference (CPU or small-GPU friendly)
   - Use for background jobs and candidate pruning before hitting the larger model

GPU footprint (ballpark for Dedicated/reserved):
- If you want low-latency 16k context at peak (48M tokens/month): reserve ~6-8 x A100-equivalent slots (this maps to throughput target ~600-900 tok/s sustained with headroom for spikes).
- If you choose 8k-high-throughput quantized route: 3-4 x A100-equivalents should cover baseline with autoscaling for spikes.

Operational suggestions (to lower unit cost quickly):
- Prefix/KV caching for user state to reduce repeated context tokens
- Mix of model variants using smart routing: default to quantized 8k for chat, fallback 16k only for large summaries or explicit long-context requests
- Canary rollout: run 10% of traffic on the 16k variant first to validate latency/cost impact and quality deltas

Next steps:
- Jordan: share a couple of redacted prompt + response examples in the Drive.
- Kimberly/Grace: decide whether we want to start the pilot on Hosted or request a Dedicated POC (Ben can map numbers to cost estimates once we pick a path).

Happy to walk through the spreadsheet tomorrow in a 30-min call.
